verification: Local contract tests against documented behavior; not verified against a live Brevo account
authentication: api-key header; default local key is twin-key
pagination: limit, offset, sort; contacts max 1000, list contacts max 500, lists and folders max 50
unsupported: OAuth, webhooks, email sending, campaigns, contact merging, imports and exports
Contacts without email, ext_id and phone identifier lookup
Attribute definitions and type enforcement; attributes accept arbitrary string, finite number, boolean or string-array values
Provider error precedence, full response metadata and exact error text
Date filters and query parameters other than listed pagination controls
List and folder update/delete; list membership add/remove endpoints (use contact listIds/unlinkListIds)
Provider latency, automatic rate limiting and network-level failures
unsupportedRequests: 501 twin_unsupported; malformed supported inputs return 400; missing records return 404
